_worked_example: ARC STEP. GDD §19.5's third of three, and the arc's closing beat. Frank speaks once, at D-1, which is GDD v2 ch.13's director ruling preserved on top of the press ladder rather than replaced by it. One option, no cost: this is a beat, not a decision, and §17.3's cost law explicitly allows that when the card is explicitly a beat.
speaker: char_mentor_frank

tr.title: Frank arıyor
tr.body:
İki yıl oldu. Şirket ayakta, sen ayaktasın, ve kapı hâlâ açılmadı.

Yarın bunu bir daha konuşmayacağız.

en.title: Frank calls
en.body:
Two years. The company is standing, you are standing, and the door never opened.

Tomorrow we do not talk about this again.
